fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami municipal affairs, including criticism of awarding city printing work outside Dade County, discussion of Florida Power & Light rates and their impact on apartment rentals, and concerns about taxation and city management. Coverage also touches on transportation and infrastructure (causeway streetcar lines, landing fields/airport sites), convention promotion and visitor treatment, prohibition enforcement anecdotes, and local sports and entertainment notices and advertisements.
